info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Status API enables users to retrieve the current status of pharmacy prescriptions, providing essential insights for both patients and healthcare providers. This API allows consumers such as pharmacists, healthcare applications, and patient portals to check on pending, filled, or refilled prescriptions. By querying the status of prescriptions, users can ensure timely access to medications and enhance patient care coordination. The API supports efficient tracking and monitoring of prescription workflows across various pharmacy systems.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of prescriptions to track their progress or any issues that might have arisen. Useful for patients and healthcare providers to stay informed about prescription fulfillment.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to obtain the status of prescriptions. It must be formatted as JSON and include the necessary schema properties as defined in the referenced schema.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, returning the current status of prescriptions.

ListPharmacyPrescriptionsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the string input for the GET operation related to the status of prescriptions.
